data.one_liner: Dart plugin wrapper for the Polar BLE SDK on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: It acts as a bridge to the Polar BLE SDK, allowing Flutter applications to connect to Polar devices, manage features, and stream sensor data like HR, ECG, and ACC.
use_when: You need to connect and interact with Polar Bluetooth devices in a Flutter app
You want to stream biometric and motion data such as heart rate or ECG from Polar hardware
avoid_when: You are building an app that does not interact with Polar hardware
You need an official first-party SDK wrapper directly from Polar
strengths: Provides direct access to Polar sensor streaming and device control
Supports multiple streams like HR, ECG, ACC, temperature, and pressure
weaknesses: It is an unofficial community-maintained wrapper for the Polar SDK
Requires manual configuration of native Bluetooth permissions and specific iOS deployment targets
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Bluetooth permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, changing the iOS deployment target to iOS 14+, and adding Bluetooth usage descriptions to Info.plist.
